The cafe

A women-owned cafe in the Red Mercantile building.

A' Latte Cafe is part of the Trolley Barn Public Market in Quakertown. Stop in for a cortado or a seasonal latte, stay for breakfast, or finish with a scoop, a sundae or an affogato.

Women-owned
  • Coffee and espresso drinks
  • Specialty lattes and drink specials
  • Teas, matcha and chai
  • Hot chocolate and refreshers
  • Baked goods
  • Breakfast daily
  • Avocado toast and quiche
  • Ice cream, sundaes and milkshakes
  • Affogato
  • Merchandise and stickers
